about: The sample corpus for `make samples` and `make e2e`, and the files the demo (`make demo`, `samples/demo.json`) loads: the `demo` set is fetched and checked only for those, or with `make samples DEMO=1`. Each sample is downloaded from the cited primary source, generated, or derived from another sample, and kept only if its sha256 matches. `uploads` says how the e2e suite uploads it (filename, which of the run's collections, declared checksum) and what each upload must become; fields left out are not checked. Mesh extents are POSITION accessor bounds in model space; footprints are WGS84 west, south, east, north. `derivatives` maps each derivative a cataloged upload must end with, and no other, to its media type, by the spec's derive rules (01-spec.md §4, step 7), not by running them: a raster whose header reads gets a PNG thumbnail, and a COG too when it has a CRS and isn't one already; a GeoPackage, Shapefile or GeoJSON whose header reads, or was too big to read within the budget, gets a GeoParquet copy; other kinds get none yet. Every COG made is checked by rio-cogeo, and every GeoParquet against the GeoParquet project's schema, not by our recipes.

samples.name: S2A_10SEG_20230618_0_L2A_TCI.tif

source.licence: Copernicus Sentinel Data Terms (free, full and open; attribution required)

samples.notes: crs, bbox (WGS84), proj:shape, proj:transform from the Earth Search STAC item (assets.visual, properties.proj:epsg); band count from the item's eo:bands (red, green, blue). Cross-checked by hand-parsing the TIFF IFD with struct: 10980x10980, 3x8-bit, 1024 tiles, deflate (code 8), ProjectedCSTypeGeoKey 32610, nodata 0; proj:bbox is native UTM 10N from tiepoint+scale. Licence is Copernicus' own terms, not an SPDX id: free use incl. commercial, attribution 'Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [year]'. Cloud-optimized: Earth Search types the asset profile=cloud-optimized, and walking the IFD chain with struct finds 1024 px tiles and four internal reduced-resolution IFDs (5490 to 687 px).

samples.name: byte.tif

source.licence: MIT

samples.notes: Hand-parsed TIFF IFD/GeoKeys with struct: 20x20, 1x8-bit, stripped (RowsPerStrip 20, uncompressed), ProjectedCSTypeGeoKey 26711 (NAD27 / UTM 11N), 60 m pixels, tiepoint (440720, 3751320). proj:bbox is native CRS; no independent WGS84 bbox computed (bbox null). Licence: GDAL LICENSE.TXT says GDAL is 'in general' MIT-style; the test file has no per-file notice. Not cloud-optimized: one stripped IFD and no overviews.

samples.name: USGS_LPC_CO_DRCOG_2020_B20_w0476n4425.laz

source.licence: Public domain (USGS)

samples.notes: Header parsed by hand with struct: LAS 1.4, point format 6 (LAZ bit set), 16389299 points (64-bit count; legacy count 0), bounds 476000-476999.999 E, 4425000-4425999.999 N, z 1732.885-1923.166. CRS from the WKT VLR (LASF_Projection 2112): COMPD_CS NAD83(2011) / UTM 13N (EPSG:6342) + NAVD88 Geoid18 (EPSG:5703); compound has no single EPSG code. Point count and native bbox agree with USGS's project VPC (https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/Elevation/LPC/Projects/CO_DRCOG_2020_B20/CO_DRCOG_1_2020/CO_DRCOG_1_2020.vpc); WGS84 bbox from the ScienceBase item / TNM API and the FGDC XML bounding. File creation day/year at offset 90, hand-parsed: day 113 of 2021 (2021-04-23), so captured that whole UTC day.

samples.notes: Header parsed by hand: LAS 1.4, point format 7, 10653336 points (matches the README's 10,653,336), first VLR is 'copc' record 1 (COPC info), bounds in US survey feet. samples.name: Copernicus_DSM_COG_30_N20_00_W157_00_DEM.tif

source.licence: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 licence (free, worldwide; attribution required)

samples.notes: Copernicus GLO-90 elevation of west Maui. A tile is named for its south-west corner and covers one degree each way, which is the bbox; hand-parsing the TIFF with struct agrees: GeographicTypeGeoKey 4326, RasterPixelIsPoint, tiepoint on the tile's north-west corner, 1200x1200 pixels (wider spacing in longitude toward the poles), so the half-pixel offset is under 0.0025 degrees. Cloud-optimized: the file opens with GDAL's COG ghost header (LAYOUT=IFDS_BEFORE_DATA, BLOCK_ORDER=ROW_MAJOR, BLOCK_LEADER and BLOCK_TRAILER, read with Python from bytes 8 to 148), which only GDAL's COG driver writes, and it is tiled with two internal overviews; so the derive rules make no COG of it.
